cd /app && cat >> call_test.go <<'EOF'

func TestCompiledFunction_Call_FunctionArgument(t *testing.T) {
	s := tengo.NewScript([]byte(`
add := func(a, b) { return a + b }
call := func(f, x) { return f(x, 1) }
`))
	c, err := s.Run()
	require.NoError(t, err)

	addFn := c.Get("add").Object().(*tengo.CompiledFunction)
	callFn := c.Get("call").Object().(*tengo.CompiledFunction)
	res, err := callFn.Call(addFn, &tengo.Int{Value: 41})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, int64(42), res.(*tengo.Int).Value)
}
EOF
cd /app && go test -run TestCompiledFunction_Call_FunctionArgument -v . 2>&1 | tail -15

cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
path='call.go'
s=open(path).read()
old='''	v.sp = 1 + numArgs
	for i := 0; i < numArgs; i++ {
		v.stack[1+i] = args[i]
	}
'''
new='''	v.sp = 1 + fn.NumLocals
	for i := 0; i < numArgs; i++ {
		v.stack[1+i] = args[i]
	}
'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(path,'w').write(s)
print("patched")
PY
cd /app && go test ./... 2>&1 | tail -12
